subject.title: feat(plugin-sdk): add escapeHtml seam and collapse six copies

question: Should `text-utility-runtime` permanently expose `escapeHtml` as a supported third-party Plugin SDK contract for HTML text and syntactic delimiter encoding?
rationale: The implementation is appropriately shared and focused, but adding a public SDK callable export creates a lasting compatibility commitment that automation cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the focused seam
options.body: Accept the additive export after narrowing its safety contract and supplying real generated-output proof.

options.title: Keep escaping plugin-local
options.body: Decline the public contract and retain or reorganize private plugin-owned helpers instead.

recommendation.title: Approve the focused seam
recommendation.body: Accept the additive export after narrowing its safety contract and supplying real generated-output proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked maintainer-labeled issue defines this exact API direction, and recent repository history connects this person to Plugin SDK and shared plugin-runtime work.
